name: Hook + Typewriter
description: Text stacks vertically. First line (hook) fades in large, remaining lines typewrite and stay on screen. Best for motivational content, simple messaging, cosmetics/lifestyle reels.

slots.name: lines
slots.description: Array of line objects: {text: string, start: number, color: string, isHook: boolean}

slots.name: charsPerSecond
slots.description: Typewriter speed in characters per second

slots.name: hookFontSize
slots.description: Font size in pixels for hook text

slots.name: bodyFontSize
slots.description: Font size in pixels for body text

example_output: Lines appear one by one, stacking vertically. Hook fades in with scale animation, other lines typewrite with blinking cursor.
